This backup belongs to a system clone app. Please enter the system clone and unlock it first, then return to the main system and tap Continue. A re-check will run when you tap Continue, and restore will start only after it passes.
System clone locked

This backup target belongs to a system clone app. Please enter the system clone and unlock it first, then return to the main system and tap Continue. A re-check will run when you tap Continue, and backup will start only after it passes.
System clone not found
This backup belongs to a system clone user that does not exist on this device (user ID: %1$s). Create a new user with root access? Data will be restored to the new user ID assigned by the system.
Clone creation failed
This device does not support creating clone users automatically. Please create the app clone manually in system settings, then return here and tap Continue.
Clone user required

This backup contains app-clone data for a user that cannot be created automatically on this device (user ID: %1$s). Enable the app clone in system settings first, return here, then tap Continue and select the new clone user.
App clone may not be enabled

These apps belong to an app clone that is not present in the clone space yet:
%1$s

The clone icon lives on the main user's home screen. Complete both steps below, then restore the clone once more for the icon to appear:
User %1$s: %2$s
Continue anyway
Open settings
Restoring into an app clone

%1$s\n\nIf the home screen shows no clone icon for these apps, the App clone switch in system settings is off. Turn it on first, otherwise the data is written into the clone space but no icon appears. Pick "Continue" to restore anyway.
Continue
App not installed in main user
%1$s\n\nThe clone icon lives on the main user\'s home screen. Complete both steps below, then restore the clone once more for the icon to appear:
Continue anyway
Step 1: install the app in the main user
Step 2: enable the app\'s clone in system settings
The order cannot be reversed: restoring the clone first and installing the main user afterwards will not bring the clone icon back. Both steps must pass, then restore the clone once more.
